messages.content: You are a precise information extraction system. You only output valid JSON.

Extract entities and events from the document below.

Entity types: Person, Organization, Location, Building, Product, Art, Other

Event types and their argument roles:
- Attack: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Consequence
- Military_operation: roles = Agent, Patient, Location
- Conquering: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Name
- Killing: roles = Killer, Victim, Location, Cause, Instrument
- Death: roles = Agent, Cause, Location, Instrument
- Bodily_harm: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Cause
- Catastrophe: roles = Patient, Location, Loss, Content
- Destroying: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Damaging: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Statement: roles = Speaker, Message, Location, Details
- Change_of_leadership: roles = New_leader, Old_leader, Location, Selector, New_Occupation, Old_Occupation
- Arriving: roles = Agent, Location

Rules:
1. Copy every entity mention, trigger and argument exactly as it appears in the document.
2. List every entity mention (including repeated mentions of the same entity).
3. Create one event entry for every trigger occurrence of the event types above. Ignore other kinds of events.
4. Arguments may appear anywhere in the document, not only in the trigger's sentence. Omit roles with no argument.

Return a JSON object in exactly this format:
{
  "entities": [
    {
      "text": "<entity mention copied from the text>",
      "type": "<entity type>"
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "trigger": "<word or short phrase in the text that signals the event>",
      "type": "<event type>",
      "arguments": {
        "<role>": [
          "<argument span copied from the text>"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

operation unk was a series of eleven nuclear test shots conducted in 1953 at the nevada test site . It followed `` Operation Ivy '' and preceded `` Operation Castle '' . over 21,000 soldiers took part in the ground exercise desert rock v in conjunction with the `` grable '' shot . `` Grable '' was a 280mm AFAP shell fired from the `` Atomic Cannon '' and was viewed by a number of high-ranking military officials . The test series was notable as containing the first time an Artillery Fired Atomic Projectile AFAP artillery shell was fired ( `` GRABLE '' Shot ) , the first two shots ( both fizzles ) by University of California Radiation Laboratory—Livermore ( now Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory ) , and for testing out some of the thermonuclear components that would be used for the massive thermonuclear series of Operation Castle . One primary device ( RACER ) was tested in thermonuclear system mockup assemblies of TX-14 , TX-16 , and TX-17/TX-24 , to examine and evaluate the behaviour of radiation cases and the compression of the secondary geometries by the primary 's x-rays prior to full-scale testing during Castle . Following RACER 's dodgy performance , the COBRA primary was used in the emergency capability ALARM CLOCK , JUGHEAD , RUNT I , RUNT II thermonuclear devices , as well as in the SHRIMP device . RACER IV ( as redesigned and proof-tested in the Simon test ) was employed as primary for the ZOMBIE , RAMROD and MORGENSTERN devices .
